text: My daily routine starts early. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and have a quick shower. After a healthy breakfast, I check my emails and plan my day. I start work at nine and follow a regular schedule with a short break at noon. In the afternoon, I often go to the gym or go running in the park because exercise helps me relax. In the evening, I cook dinner and spend time with my family, then read a book before bed. I try to keep the same routine every day because consistency gives me energy and helps me stay organised.
